description: Dashboard alert de-duplication and escalation policy. A condition alerts once, remains quiet while unchanged, alerts again when it worsens, and can alert again after resolution if it reappears. Market Data Desk startup/flapping conditions use a short re-arm grace period, so a condition that resolves and reappears within the grace window only re-alerts if severity or magnitude worsens. M158-M160 extend this to evidence auto-recovery and source-ingest gaps that remain after a watch-loop or dashboard-loop pre-snapshot refresh.
dedupe_rules: emit an alert when a condition key appears for the first time
do not emit repeat alerts while the same condition remains unchanged
emit another alert when severity rank increases
emit another alert when magnitude worsens by max(worsening_min_delta, last_alerted_magnitude * worsening_relative)
mark inactive condition keys as resolved in state
when a resolved condition reappears, treat it as a new condition
for Market Data Desk startup/flapping conditions, suppress quick reappearance alerts during the grace window unless severity or magnitude worsens
resolution alert rows are disabled by default
